details.effect: On Evolve - Put an Ancient Artifact token into your EX area. On Super-Evolve - Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal 4 damage to it and 2 damage to its leader.

issues: On Super-Evolve is missing the required enemy follower selection; encode it as a targeted effect that selects 1 enemy follower, then deals 4 damage to that follower and 2 damage to its leader, rather than an untargeted damageFollowerAndLeader effect.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost02]: Evolve this follower. Ward. [act] Lesson (1): Select another card that costs 1 or less on your field and return it to its owner's hand. For the rest of this turn, this card's [act] abilities except [evolve] can't be activated.

issues: The activated Lesson (1) ability is encoded with cost.pp: 0, but Lesson (1) means the activated ability itself should have cost {"pp":1} rather than using optionalCost with a free activation.

The activated Lesson (1) ability incorrectly uses optionalCost for returning another 1-cost-or-less card; that return is mandatory as part of the effect, not an optional additional cost, so encode it as a sequence/effect that returns another card on your field with maxCost 1.

The self-restriction after Lesson (1) should be 'this card's [act] abilities except [evolve] can't be activated' until end of turn; the current structure should use grantActRestriction with exceptEvolve true as part of the activated effect after the return.

details.effect: Ward. On Evolve - Select an enemy follower that costs 2 or less on the field and return it to its owner's hand. [act] Lesson (1): Select another card that costs 1 or less on your field and return it to its owner's hand. For the rest of this turn, this card's [act] abilities can't be activated.

issues: The activated Lesson (1) ability is encoded with cost.pp: 0, but Lesson (1) means the activated ability itself should have cost {"pp":1}.

The activated Lesson (1) ability incorrectly uses optionalCost for returning another 1-cost-or-less card; that return is mandatory effect text, not an optional cost, so encode it as a normal activated effect that returns another card on your field with maxCost 1.

The self-restriction after Lesson (1) is overbroadly/incorrectly encoded; evolved Yuzu says 'this card's [act] abilities can't be activated' this turn, so encode grantActRestriction without exceptEvolve, applied after the return.

details.effect: Bane. [fanfare] Each opponent buries a follower. Necrocharge (10) - They bury 2 instead. [act] [cost03], discard this card: Select an enemy follower on the field. Deal it 5 damage and bury the top card of your deck.

issues: The base fanfare effect should be 'Each opponent buries a follower. Necrocharge (10) - They bury 2 instead.' but parsed encodes two separate fanfare abilities, causing both to resolve when Necrocharge (10) is met. Replace with a single conditional fanfare using if/necrocharge so it buries 2 instead of 1, not in addition to 1.
